section_summary.extract_value: This introduction reviews the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revision (BAS-2), summarizes prior cross-cultural validations, and states the present study's aim to evaluate the psychometric properties of a Persian BAS-2 in Iran. It also states hypotheses that BAS-2 scores will correlate positively with self-esteem and life satisfaction, negatively with BMI, and that sex differences (men > women) will be evaluated.
